C1.source_quote: The line of head from the commencement of the line of life, and connected with it (d-d, Plate XVI.), indicates a sensitive and more nervous temperament; it denotes excess of caution; even clever people with this mark rein themselves down too tightly.

C2.source_quote: The line of life should be long, narrow, and deep, without irregularities, breaks, or crosses of any kind. Such a formation promises long life, good health, and vitality.

C3.source_quote: Venus be well developed, it indicates strong and robust health.

C4.source_quote: When developed it shows ambition, pride, enthusiasm in anything attempted, and desire for power.

C5.source_quote: This is found at the base of the second finger (Plate XII.), and denotes love of solitude, quietness, prudence, earnestness in work, proneness to the study of somber things, and appreciation of music of a sacred or classical order.

C6.source_quote: This, the first, gives active courage, the martial spirit, but when large, shows a very quarrelsome, fighting disposition.

reading_text:
The head line on your palm, rising from the commencement of the life line and connected with it, reveals a sensitive and more nervous temperament. This connection indicates an excess of caution, which can lead even the cleverest individuals to restrain themselves too tightly. Your life line is long, narrow, and deep, without any irregularities. This promises you a long life, accompanied by good health and vitality. The Mount of Venus on your hand is well developed, further indicating strong and robust health.

Turning to the Mount of Jupiter, its development shows ambition, pride, and enthusiasm in anything you undertake, along with a desire for power. The Mount of Saturn, however, is not notably developed, which denotes a love of solitude, quietness, prudence, earnestness in work, a taste for sombre subjects, and an appreciation of sacred or classical music. The Upper Mount of Mars gives you active courage and a martial spirit.

A note on what I have not interpreted: the classical texts I work from do not clearly address the following as they appear in your hands: heart line, fate line, sun line, thumb, fingers, mount of apollo, mount of mercury, mount of mars negative, mount of luna. Rather than guess, I have left these out of your reading.

For major life decisions, I recommend consulting a qualified astrologer or palm reader for a personal reading.
